subject: music
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: A plagal cadence (often called the 'Amen' cadence) is:
questions.explain: A plagal cadence moves from chord IV to chord I.
Legato means smooth and connected, with no gaps between notes.

questions.q: Which Italian tempo term means 'fast and lively'?
questions.explain: Allegro means fast and lively, whereas adagio and largo are slow.

questions.q: A minim is worth how many crotchet beats?
questions.explain: A minim is worth two crotchet beats.
Ritardando means to gradually slow the tempo down.

questions.q: Which term describes a melody supported by chords moving in the same rhythm?
questions.explain: Homophonic texture is a clear melody accompanied by chords.

questions.q: What does the time signature 3/4 tell you?
options: Four beats in a bar, each a crotchet
Three beats in a bar, each a crotchet
Three beats in a bar, each a quaver
questions.explain: In 3/4 there are three crotchet beats per bar, giving a waltz feel.

options: Two or more independent melodic lines sounding together
questions.explain: Polyphonic texture combines two or more independent melodic lines.

questions.q: Compared with a major scale, a (natural) minor key generally sounds:
questions.explain: Minor keys typically sound darker or sadder than the brighter major.

options: A single melodic line with no accompaniment
questions.explain: Monophonic texture is a single unaccompanied melodic line.

questions.q: What does a natural sign do?
options: Lowers a note by a tone
Raises a note by a tone
Cancels a previous sharp or flat
questions.explain: A natural cancels a sharp or flat, returning the note to its natural pitch.

questions.q: The articulation marking 'staccato' tells a player to make notes:
questions.explain: Staccato means short and detached, the opposite of legato.
